sql:
select
  channel,
  sum(case when started_at >= date '2025-01-01' and started_at < date '2026-01-01' then 1 else 0 end) as sessions_2025,
  round(100.0 * sum(case when started_at >= date '2025-01-01' and started_at < date '2026-01-01' then 1 else 0 end)
    / nullif(sum(sum(case when started_at >= date '2025-01-01' and started_at < date '2026-01-01' then 1 else 0 end)) over (), 0), 1) as share_of_2025_sessions_pct,
  sum(case when started_at >= date '2024-01-01' and started_at < date '2025-01-01' then 1 else 0 end) as sessions_2024,
  round(100.0 * (
    sum(case when started_at >= date '2025-01-01' and started_at < date '2026-01-01' then 1 else 0 end)
    - sum(case when started_at >= date '2024-01-01' and started_at < date '2025-01-01' then 1 else 0 end)
  ) / nullif(sum(case when started_at >= date '2024-01-01' and started_at < date '2025-01-01' then 1 else 0 end), 0), 1) as yoy_change_pct,
  round(100.0 * sum(case when started_at >= date '2025-01-01' and started_at < date '2026-01-01' and is_bounce then 1 else 0 end)
    / nullif(sum(case when started_at >= date '2025-01-01' and started_at < date '2026-01-01' then 1 else 0 end), 0), 1) as bounce_rate_2025_pct,
  round(avg(case when started_at >= date '2025-01-01' and started_at < date '2026-01-01' then page_view_count end), 1) as avg_page_views_2025
from (
  select
    coalesce(nullif(trim(utm_source), ''), 'direct/none') as channel,
    started_at,
    is_bounce,
    page_view_count
  from web_sessions
) s
group by channel
order by sessions_2025 desc, channel asc
limit 12
note: Channel mix and YoY shift across all merchants, top 12 channels by 2025 sessions; bounce rate and avg page views cover 2025 only as requested.
